2. Reason: The planner incorrectly assumes that paired nursery rhymes get adjacent Roud numbers and infers the girls’ version should be Roud 822. Roud numbers group variants under the same number; evidence already shows “What Are Little Girls Made Of” is included under Roud 821. This misassumption could misdirect the search. Additionally, it misattributes the Step 6 source (which showed a Chappell recording) to the Wiseman book.
